'''Rocky road''' is a type of [[Cookbook:Confections|confectionery]] commonly made in Australia. It is made from chunks of [[Cookbook:Marshmallow|marshmallow]] in a matrix of chocolate. This is a similar recipe to [[Cookbook:Rocky Road Confectionery|Rocky Road Confectionery l]].
==Ingredients==
* 375 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Chocolate|milk chocolate]]
* 30 g [[Cookbook:Coconut oil|coconut oil]]
* 350 g [[Cookbook:Marshmallow|marshmallows]]

== Equipment ==
* [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|Baking paper]]
* Pan
* [[Cookbook:Microwave|Microwave]]
* Big bowl
==Procedure==
# Put the chocolate in the bowl and microwave until melted. Then, once the chocolate is melted, stir in the coconut oil, which will get melted by the chocolate.
# Let cool slightly, then [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in the marshmallows.
# Spread mixture in a greased and parchment-lined pan. Let set.
# Unmold and cut into pieces.
